definitions.explanation: A visual representation created by drawing, painting, or other artistic means.
A picture in a book or document that explains or decorates the text.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{絵|え}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}いている→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: The child is drawing a picture.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{絵|え}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧です。
examples.english: This painting is a work by a famous artist.
I hung a picture on the wall.

examples.english: Please look at the illustration in the explanation.

examples.english: I listened to the teacher while looking at the illustrations in the textbook.

notes:
{絵|え} is the everyday word for pictures and drawings.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {絵|え}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧ (to draw/paint a picture)
- {絵|え}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to look at a picture)
- {絵|え}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧ (to display a picture)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{絵本|えほん}→絵本：10429_ehon⟧ (picture book)
- {絵|え}⟦はがき→はがき：00699_hagaki⟧ (picture postcard)
- ⟦{油絵|あぶらえ}→油絵：07076_aburae⟧ (oil painting)
- ⟦{水彩画|すいさいが}→水彩画：07077_suisaiga⟧ (watercolor painting)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {絵|え}: picture (casual, everyday)
- ⟦{絵画|かいが}→絵画：02597_kaiga⟧: painting (formal, art context)
- {画|が}: painting (in compounds like ⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧, ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧)
